description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katukurunduwatta, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No.521005
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 116 and 24) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land settlement and title registration processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
